import { Component, OnInit, ViewChild, ElementRef } from '@angular/core'; import { LicnaKarta } from "../../models/LicnaKarta"; import { ZahteviService } from "../../services/Zahtevi.service"; declare var bootstrap: any; @Component({ selector: 'app-licna', templateUrl: './licna.component.html', styleUrls: ['./licna.component.css'] }) export class LicnaComponent implements OnInit { @ViewChild('zahtevModal') zahtevModalRef!: ElementRef; zahtevi: LicnaKarta[] = []; token: string = ''; noviZahtev = { jmbg: '', datumRodjenja: '', pol: 'M', grad: '' }; modalInstance: any; constructor(private zahteviService: ZahteviService) { } ngOnInit(): void { this.ucitajZahteve(); } ngAfterViewInit() { this.modalInstance = new bootstrap.Modal(this.zahtevModalRef.nativeElement); } ucitajZahteve() { this.zahteviService.getSviZahtevi(this.token).subscribe({ next: (data) => this.zahtevi = data, error: (err) => console.error(err) }); } openZahtevModal() { this.modalInstance.show(); } podnesiZahtev() { console.log('Podnesi zahtev:', this.noviZahtev); this.modalInstance.hide(); } }
